_about: Companion to docs/implementation-audit-2026-11-22.md. Generated 2026-11-22 from branch audit/implementation (off integrate/0.5.0 a696ccc8).

spells: verdict from the engine's own readers (spells.casting_plan, Engine._executes, engine._ac_grant, Engine._gate_applies, the _condition_term rules) at caster level 5; ran = specs that execute, told = specs only rendered for the GM. 'why' on a non-FULL spell: vocabulary = every unexecuted spec is a narrative spec (the reading had no type for it); executor = a typed spec exists and nothing runs it.

feats: FULL = a mechanics document with no not_yet; PARTIAL = document with not_yet (quoted); NARRATED = no document (why = a regex triage of the benefit prose naming the machinery it needs - a planning signal, not a verdict); N/A = mythic or monster-only. takeable = non-mythic with every prerequisite machine-checkable.
class_features: rows [class, level, feature, verdict, reason] from the class-feature probe; fam = option families; gp = granted powers (domains, bloodlines, schools, bonds); bb = blood-bending paths.
skills: per-skill uses hand-traced in code (resolved = DC/opposed roll computed AND consequence applied).

rows: "Any ability that requires patience or concentration": only skills are refused while it holds; casting and concentration are not.; Indomitable will's +4 against enchantment: saves carry no enchantment descriptor yet.; Rounds only drain in played rounds; a rage begun out of a fight holds until it is ended.
against: trap — no save or attack roll says it comes from a trap yet (the hazard op's saves pass no descriptor), so both terms are dropped, never applied
rage not_yet: +4 Will vs enchantment needs a save descriptor
pool + 4 of 6 lvl1-10 performances documented; countersong, distraction, suggestion absent
A threat breaking the fascination early: the condition holds until the performance ends.
The morale bonus on saves against charm and fear: saves carry no charm or fear descriptor yet.; Hearing: everyone on the bard's side in the scene is inspired; distance and deafness are not read.
The two bonus Hit Dice counting as Hit Dice for effects like sleep.
house-rule overrides + ability_growth apply; other benders' Con check absent
With no map, everyone in the scene is in the burst.; Excluding chosen creatures (Selective Channeling): the burst takes everyone it reaches, as the book does.

Elemental body (6th, 8th, 10th, 12th), plant shape (8th on), and beast shape III's Diminutive and Huge animals (8th).; The form's movement (climb, fly, swim) and senses (darkvision, low-light vision, scent).; Gear melding is the armour and shield bonuses only (Actor._melded_gear, 2026-10-06): an item that must be activated still works in the shape.; Casting while shaped is not refused (the book needs Natural Spell for it).; At will at 20th: the pool still counts uses.
against: fear — no save yet says it is against fear (spell saves pass only "spell"), so the term is dropped, never applied

the bonus on combat maneuver checks made with a weapon of the group, and to CMD against disarm and sunder: the manoeuvre roll does not say which weapon makes it; the picks themselves: the class-choice writer is lane 1's (docs/class-audit.md §8); read through classfeatures.chosen
The extra use a day for every four levels in classes other than monk: the app's characters have one class.
against: enchantment — spell saves pass only "spell", never the school, so the term is dropped, never applied
pool + ki dodge/ki speed docs; extra flurry attack, ki strike tie absent
adamantine's "bypassing hardness" when a fist strikes an object: sundering is a weapon's, not the fist's, in the manoeuvre table
treated as an outsider rather than a humanoid for spells and magical effects: no spell targets by creature type yet
The mercies that act through a spell: diseased (remove disease), cursed (remove curse), poisoned (neutralize poison).; Touch is checked on the map (5 ft); with no map it is taken on trust.
the allies' +4 morale bonus against fear within 10 feet
With no map, everyone in the scene is in the burst.; Excluding chosen creatures (Selective Channeling): the burst takes everyone it reaches, as the book does.
the allies' +4 morale bonus against charm within 10 feet
"Any attack made against an enemy within 10 feet of her is treated as good-aligned" — allies' attacks
the allies' +4 morale bonus against compulsion within 10 feet
smite evil's banishment of an evil outsider: smite is lane 4's ability document
the skill terms: a skill roll carries no target, so they are dropped, never applied; Knowledge checks against them: which Knowledge skill identifies which type is not modelled
"A ranger traveling through his favored terrain normally leaves no trail": no tracking op

the Perception half is "to locate traps": no skill roll says what it is looking for, so it is dropped, never applied; "A rogue can use Disable Device to disarm magic traps": no trap op distinguishes them
against: trap — no save or attack roll says it comes from a trap yet, so both terms are dropped, never applied
granted as feat; components not tracked
granted as feat; crafting is the feat's
gp: Spending a round: there is no op that runs a spell-like ability by rounds, so the pool is counted and the talking is the GM's.
Objects and their hardness: nothing in a scene but a creature has hit points yet, so the touch reaches constructs only (content/class-abilities/domains.json).
A weapon fighting on its own: there is no dancing-weapon actor yet.
Rolling twice and keeping the worse: no d20 reader takes a second roll yet, so the touch is counted and the misfortune is the GM's to narrate.
The anarchic quality on the weapon: a weapon property granted for rounds has no reader yet, so the uses are counted and the blade's new edge is the GM's to narrate.
The charm itself: a spell-like ability that runs by rounds has no op, so the rounds are counted and the charm is the GM's (the mind gate refuses an attitude change without an origin).
Lending a save: the save op rolls each creature's own.
A miss chance laid on the target's own attacks: concealment is read off the defender, and no effect yet makes everyone concealed from one attacker.
Turning the sight on by rounds: no op spends a power by rounds yet.
The bleeding: damage each round is a periodic effect, and periodic damage has no executor yet (docs/states-effects-tells.md, Promised).
Attacks against creatures inside an aura: a bonus to the attacker that depends on where the defender stands has no reader yet.
Counting the target as good for spells with the evil descriptor: no spell reads an alignment, by the 2026-09-19 ruling.
The unholy quality on the weapon: a weapon property granted for rounds has no reader yet, so the uses are counted and the blade's new edge is the GM's to narrate.
A bonus spent on the next roll of a kind: no effect yet ends itself when it is used.
Sanctuary on allies: the ward that stops attackers has no reader for an aura yet.
The bonus on ability checks: no roll reads an ability check yet (attacks, saves and skills take it).
The holy quality on the weapon: a weapon property granted for rounds has no reader yet, so the uses are counted and the blade's new edge is the GM's to narrate.
Empowering the cure: the cast op rolls a spell's dice as its prose says and reads no tag of the caster's.
Learning of the creature: the knowledge check is the GM's; the book gives this touch no limit a day.
Scrying by rounds: no op spends a power by rounds yet.
Fixing the d20 at 11: no roll reads a set face yet.
The axiomatic quality on the weapon: a weapon property granted for rounds has no reader yet, so the uses are counted and the blade's new edge is the GM's to narrate.
Slipping magical holds: freedom of movement has no reader yet, so the rounds are counted and the escape is the GM's.
Suppressing conditions for allies in an aura: no aura effect exists yet.
Rolling twice and keeping the better: no d20 reader takes a second roll yet.
The reroll: an immediate action after a roll has no op yet.
Choosing which of the three is raised: a choice of overlays on a touch is not written for this power yet.
The day's immunity for a creature that saved, and confusion ending when it leaves the aura: no aura tracks who stands in it.
The flying strike: an attack with a melee weapon at range, rolled off Wis, has no field yet.
The dispel: a caster-level check against a spell's effect has no op for a power yet.
The bonus on ability checks: no roll reads an ability check yet (attacks, saves and skills take it).
The +2 Leadership score and followers: no cohort is modelled.

Turning the fists on: a toggled power needs a `toggles` row, and those are read off a class path only (rules/leveling.py, another lane's file). The rounds are counted; the damage bonus does not land yet.
